description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to notification forwarding policies in an Android app, including package filtering, quiet hours management, and rate limiting.

classes.name: NotificationPackageFilterMode
classes.description: Enum representing filter modes (allowlist or blocklist) for notification packages, with a companion object for creating instances from raw string values.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the notification forwarding rules, such as enabled state, mode, package set, quiet hours settings, and max events per minute.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: Class implementing a rate limiter to control the number of notification events allowed in a sliding one-minute window.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Creates a NotificationPackageFilterMode enum from a raw string value.

methods.name: allowsPackage
methods.description: Checks if a given package name is allowed based on the current filtering mode and package list.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Determines whether the current time (or provided epoch time) falls within the configured quiet hours.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string into a HH:MM format if valid.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Parses a raw string into total minutes from midnight if valid.

methods.name: allow
methods.description: Determines whether a notification event is permitted based on the current rate limiter state.
